item.title: The team behind Tailwind CSS is joining Shopify
item.description: We're joining Shopify to give Tailwind a stable long-term home where it will be actively maintained for the millions of people who depend on it. (4 sources: frontendfocus, hackernews, nodeweekly, rubyweekly)

item.title: From C to Ruby: Porting Doom
Surviving Black Friday: 329 billion requests with Falcon
You Are an Expensive Babysitter
item.description: Platform-integrated autoscaling based on request queue time and job queue latency. For Ruby apps running on Heroku, Render, Railway, Fly.io, Scalingo, and Amazon ECS. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: a new privacy-safe star history API
item.description: Track repository star growth over time with the new star history REST API endpoint without exposing stargazer identities. Earlier this year, stargazer listing endpoints were restricted to admins and collaborators… (2 sources: javascriptweekly, rubyweekly)

item.title: a little more background
item.description: GitHub just shipped a privacy-safe star history endpoint. Star History adopted it immediately. Charts work again, and large-repo charts are now more accurate. (2 sources: javascriptweekly, rubyweekly)

item.title: Introducing Rubydex Linter: Structural Checks for Ruby Projects
item.description: Rubydex linter is Rubydex’s built-in linter for writing project-specific structural rules that use Rubydex’s understanding of a codebase. (1 source: rubyweekly)
